Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry) workflow using GFP-tagged baits and label-free spectral counting for quantification. While the search parameters included phosphorylation and acetylation, these were used as variable modifications for protein identification in the interactome, not as the primary target of a PTM-enrichment assay (like TiO2 or anti-acetyl-lysine beads).
